trap.label: have/get + particípio (serviço)
trap.wrong: Where do you do your nails? I fixed my phone last week at the mall.
trap.right: Where do you get your nails done? I got my phone fixed last week at the mall.
trap.why: Em português “fazer as unhas” e “consertar o celular” não marcam que outra pessoa fez. Em inglês, para serviço use have/get + objeto + particípio.

mcq.q: I ___ my hair cut every month.
Where did you get your shoes ___?

fix.wrong: He had cut his beard at a barber.
fix.right: He had his beard cut at a barber.

fix.wrong: I need to have repair my bike.
fix.right: I need to have my bike repaired.
